nodes.label: Folk-Catholic Syncretism
nodes.evidence_status: Population shares, penal history, chapel building, stations, holy wells, Devotional Revolution, and wake customs are fact-checked with corrections.
nodes.rationale: Mass, rosary, stations, wells, fairies, pisheogs, blessed objects, wakes, and seasonal ritual formed a coherent popular religious world before later standardization.

nodes.label: Established-Church Tension
nodes.rationale: A small established Church of Ireland funded by universal tithes, plus Orange influence and a Catholic majority emerging from suppression, made sectarian authority structurally visible.
